summary: Iteration 3 — full backend + frontend regression for Pavlovića med. Backend (11/11 pytest pass) confirms 3 products with cvetni-med replacing livadski-med, external Cvetni image URL reachable, static images for bagremov & suncokretov OK, contact endpoint validates and persists. Frontend (Playwright on live preview URL) confirms gallery fully removed (no #galerija, no nav/mobile/footer link), bees-on-frame hero image, subtitle text 'bagremov, suncokretov i cvetni', logo image rendered in navbar and footer (src contains 9stvciqb/df09757a), 3 product cards (no livadski), Cvetni image is external customer-assets URL, About has 2 stats + decorative logo watermark (alt='', aria-hidden), Poruči on Cvetni prefills contact form with subject 'Porudžbina: Cvetni med', and contact form submits successfully (success toast 'Hvala! Vaša poruka je poslata. Javljamo se uskoro.' + form cleared).

issues: Footer copy still reads 'Prirodan med — bagremov, suncokretov i livadski — brano sa pažnjom i ljubavlju...' but product was renamed to 'Cvetni med'. Should be updated to '...bagremov, suncokretov i cvetni...' for consistency. File: /app/frontend/src/components/site/Footer.jsx line ~35-36.

action_items: Update Footer.jsx description text: replace 'livadski' with 'cvetni' to match the renamed product (minor copy fix).
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx hardcoded copy 'bagremov, suncokretov i livadski' wasn't updated when product was renamed to cvetni — same risk for any other hardcoded variety lists; consider sourcing variety names from PRODUCTS / site-data.
Hero.jsx alt text 'Med koji se sliva sa saća' (honey dripping from comb) no longer matches the new bees-on-frame + rapeseed hero image; recommend updating alt for accessibility/SEO.

Server-side PRODUCTS list is hardcoded in server.py; harmless for MVP but mixing two image-hosting strategies (local /api/static vs external customer-assets URL) is inconsistent — fine, but worth aligning long-term.
Backend has no DELETE/PUT routes for contact messages; acceptable for marketing site, just noting that TEST_-prefixed contact records accumulate in MongoDB (no cleanup endpoint).
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed contact_messages docs created via /api/contact during tests (TEST_Marko, TEST_Seed3) and one UI submission (TEST_Auto Tester). No cleanup endpoint available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 verified: gallery removed, cvetni replaces livadski, logo image in navbar/footer/about watermark. Only outstanding issue is footer description text still saying 'livadski' — main agent can self-verify after fixing. test_backend.py updated and parameterized for bagremov+suncokretov only; pytest must be run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported from /app/frontend/.env.
